title: Scientists Catch a Rare Glimpse of a Fish With a See-Through Head - Nautilus
gist: A remotely operated vehicle captured about 20 minutes of rare 4K footage of the semi-transparent-headed barreleye fish nearly 2,000 feet deep in Monterey Canyon.

insights.claim: Around 20 minutes of 4K video of the rarely observed barreleye fish (spookfish), whose head front is semi-transparent, was recorded by a remotely operated vehicle nearly 2,000 feet below the surface in California's Monterey Canyon.
insights.so_what: Illustrates ROV-imaging capability for deep-ocean observation; no direct market angle.
insights.quote: Around 20 minutes of 4K video was recorded by a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) nearly 2,000 feet below the surface
insights.speaker: David Nield
